description: This source file implements file utility functions for filename manipulation and file I/O operations within the project, including opening, reading, and writing files, as well as stripping extensions from filenames.

methods.name: char * lu5_name_without_extention(const char * filename)
methods.description: Removes the extension from a filename string.

methods.name: FILE * lu5_open_file(const char * path,const char * mode)
methods.description: Opens a file with the specified mode, handling errors and integrating with Lua if needed.

methods.name: int lu5_write_file(const char * path,const void * buffer,size_t len)
methods.description: Writes a buffer to a file at the specified path.

methods.name: char * lu5_read_file(const char * path,long * size)
methods.description: Reads the entire contents of a file into a buffer, returning size and handling memory allocation.

ctags.name: lu5_write_file
ctags.pattern: /^int lu5_write_file(const char *path, const void *buffer, size_t len) $/
